title_sq: Tek Ali Demi, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Dhe Vendndodhje Perfekte !!
description_sq: Ne Zonen e Ali Demit, afer shkolles Kushtrimi i Lirise, shitet Apartament 2+1+2 tualete. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri te perfunduar, se fundmi, me siperfaqe totale 148 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 130 m2. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1 banim dhe eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne verande, dy dhoma gjumi me dalje ne veranden e bollshme dhe dy tualete, njeri me dritare. Duke qene kati i pare banim dhe buze rruge kryesore, eshte nje mundesi shume e mire dhe per investim per biznes. Apartamenti eshte ne proces hipotekimi.
title_en: At Ali Demi, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect layout and location!!
description_en: In the Ali Demi area, near Kushtrimi i Lirise school, 2+1+2 bathroom apartment for sale. The apartment is located in a new building, recently completed, with a total area of ​​148 m2 and a net area of ​​130 m2. The apartment is located on the 1st residential floor and is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner and access to the veranda, two bedrooms with access to the spacious veranda and two toilets, one with a window. Being a residential first floor and on the edge of the main road, it is a very good opportunity for business investment. The apartment is in the mortgage process.
